finding_under_test: Multi-deposit evasion: a tiny first deposit exempts a wallet from every amount rule (143 wallets, 2.97% pts, 47 ring members, 5 treasury wallets, 3 flagged)
verdict: partially right; core numbers reproduce but ring attribution is overstated, treasury list is mislabeled and mostly outside the finding definition, and the 143 set is dominated by human test-then-real depositors; the real exemption exploit (176-wallet 9.9-10.4 ladder bot, 1.9% pts, 0 flagged) is outside the finding entirely

code_check.conclusion: exemption is real for amount/split/cadence; any multi-deposit wallet (not just tiny-first) is exempt

suggested_fix_evaluation.method: full detect() re-run with each multi-deposit wallet collapsed to its largest deposit (variant largest) or only when largest >= 5 ETH (variant largest_ge5); points from the original run
suggested_fix_evaluation.ring_reach: largest-deposit byte-identical partner within +-1h exists for 31/47 ring multi wallets (all 31 partners are ring wallets) but the full re-run flags only 6 ring wallets (0.23% pts): windows of 1-8 do not clear the >=5-member/2-family gate on their own
suggested_fix_evaluation.conclusion: as suggested (largest or every deposit) the fix is a false-positive generator: +889 wallets/+129 ENS for +6 ring wallets; the <0.1->>=5-in-2h signal fires on 76 non-ring wallets (19 ENS, 44 hour-saver ladderers) for 33 ring wallets

ladder_bot.mechanics: strictly serial single process: 5 deposits in 4-6 consecutive blocks (one per block), next wallet starts 6-9 blocks later, 0 overlapping pairs of 106; enrichment coverage 0 (never candidates)

ladder_bot.volume_share: ladder volume / total volume: h41 734/776, h42 953/1027, h43 2683/2743, h44 2041/2134, h45 881/906 ETH -> this bot is what kept the game alive in h37-46
ladder_bot.not_in_finding: first deposits 9.9/10.0 so outside the <0.5-first definition; the finding frames the hole as tiny-first when it is any-multi-deposit

what_the_exemption_actually_hides.human_ladders_for_contrast: 0.05,0.15,0.25,0.35,0.45 x169 (10 ENS, h1-44, 0.40% pts) and other 0.05-step ladders: the measured false-positive class the exemption was designed for; a naive identical-sequence rule would need a >=5 ETH floor

strongest_supported_claim: The single-deposit gate on amount/split/cadence is a real blind spot, but its cost is misattributed: (a) 32-35 multi-deposit members of the ~97 ETH ring (1.2-1.3% pts) escape, and only 6 of them would be caught even by the suggested fix; (b) two peel-chain/collector wallets escape (0.016% pts); (c) the 9.9-10.3 x107 and 10.0-10.4 x69 serial ladder bot (176 wallets, 1.91% pts, 0 flagged, 0 ENS, kept the game alive h37-46) is the largest exploit and is not tiny-first; (d) the remaining ~108 wallets of the 143 (1.66% pts) are predominantly aged, ENS-dense (27%) humans doing a 0.05 test deposit before a real one and must not be flagged.
